# Terser build fetches and the toolchain reference list are separate configuration inputs

The initial Terser patch adds 19 optimized build fetch requests and separately adds terser to the toolchain reference list. The local loader matches referenced tasks by name or alias from another task hierarchy; it does not define the tool implementation, and its missing-reference check is inactive. Win32/opt is absent from the initial additions and receives its request in the next follow-up. The fixed source retains 17 original named consumers while the two ASAN reporter job names are absent; later consumer additions are distinct phases. Static configuration does not prove graph generation, tool availability or minified output.

Scope: Taskcluster optimized build toolchains.
